title: Evaluation of two independent protocols for the extraction of DNA and RNA from different tissues of sea cucumber Isostichopus badionotus
author: Puch-Hau, Sánchez-Tapia, et al.

steps.title: Powder tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 25 mg of Isostichopus badionotus tissue, freeze it in liquid nitrogen, grind to a fine powder, and transfer the powder to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add ATL buffer
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL Buffer ATL to the tube containing the powdered tissue and homogenize.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL proteinase K to the homogenate and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 56 °C for 2 h, vortexing briefly every ~15 min, until complete lysis is observed.

steps.title: Add AL buffer
steps.instruction: Vortex the lysate for 15 s, add 200 µL Buffer AL, and mix vigorously for 10 s to avoid precipitate formation.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 100 % ethanol to the mixture and mix for 10 s.

steps.title: Load spin column
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, transfer the entire mixture onto a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube, avoiding any precipitate that could block the column.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 3 min (or until the lysate has passed through the column). Discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with AW1
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to the centre of the column (do not touch the filter), and centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 min. Discard the flow‑through and tube.

steps.title: Wash with AW2
steps.instruction: Place the column in a fresh 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2 to the centre, and centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 3 min. Discard the flow‑through and tube.

steps.title: Remove residual AW2
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for an additional 1 min at 13 000 rpm to eliminate residual Buffer AW2. Discard the flow‑through and tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 20 µL ultrapure water to the centre of the column, incubate 5 min at room temperature (15–25 °C), then centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 min to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Second elution (concentration)
steps.instruction: Re‑apply the eluate to the same column, centrifuge again at 8 000 rpm for 1 min to increase DNA concentration, then store the final eluate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity with a Nanodrop 1000 and evaluate integrity by 1 % agarose‑gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Powder tissue for RNA
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 100 mg of sea cucumber tissue, freeze in liquid nitrogen, grind to a fine powder, and place the powder in a cold 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add TRIzol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL TRIzol™ Reagent to the powdered tissue and vortex vigorously until fully homogenized.

steps.title: Overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the homogenate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Initial centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C. If phase separation is not visible, repeat centrifugation for an additional 10 min.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube, add 200 µL cold chloroform, vortex vigorously for 15 s, and incubate 2–3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Phase separation centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 15 min at 4 °C, then transfer the aqueous (upper) phase to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: RNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL cold isopropanol to the aqueous phase, mix by inversion, and incubate for 2 h at –20 °C.

steps.title: Pellet wash with 75 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and wash the RNA pellet with 1 mL cold 75 % ethanol.

steps.title: Pellet wash with 100 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet again with 1 mL cold 100 % ethanol and centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the RNA pellet under cold conditions for 10–15 min, then resuspend in 20–50 µL nuclease‑free water containing RNase inhibitors (5 µL RNasin® per 2 mL water). Store the RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality
steps.instruction: Determine RNA concentration and purity with a Nanodrop 1000 and evaluate integrity by 2 % agarose‑gel electrophoresis.
